segments.dry: A reviewer with normal-to-dry skin in a dry climate reports improvement in fine lines and redness with consistent use, while another reviewer not specifying skin type found the product left her face feeling tight and dry after a single use.
segments.normal: One reviewer describes her skin as normal-to-dry and reports smoother skin and reduced fine lines after consistent use.

concerns.aging: Reviewers report reduced fine lines and forehead wrinkles with weeks of consistent use; one reviewer states results take 8-12 weeks and cautions against expecting quick effects.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with normal-to-dry skin noticed a reduction in slight redness around her mouth and chin after consistent use.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers describe the serum as leaving skin smooth and hydrated; one reviewer, after a single use, instead reports her skin felt tight and dry.

Then you you get the perks of removing dead skin cells that clog up your beautiful face/neck! Tips, put a few drops in your hands and PRESS into your skin (especially those stubborn places that you would love to see improvement) Then you can take a little and dab in the rest of your face and neck. Pressing this skin loving oil in REALLY makes it one with your skin. Cons, you don't get much AT ALL for the price! They have used some fantastic ingredients and after doing research on their labs and where they get their ingredients, definitely an expensive mixture for them to mix and they have to make profit. However they could cut a few corners by changing up the packaging. Although squeeze tubes aren't as pretty and they would have to make one that doesn't leak as this is THIN oil. That alone could save and allow for some price difference. In the end…it's a beautiful formula that truly helps your skin! Wrinkles can reduce. Your skin can plump, you'll notice a difference with weeks of use (nothing great happens quickly; never forget that!) So if you can find it in your budget, I HIGHLY recommend trying this baby out. I'm on my second bottle now and have been using it consistently day and night, and I love what it is doing for my skin. The smell and texture are amazing, and I absolutely love the soft, almost glass-like feel it gives my face. I've noticed improvement in the fine lines on my forehead and the slight redness around my mouth and chin. I am a believer and will continue using this product! For reference, I'm 41 with normal-to-dry skin and live in a dry climate.
